description: This file defines the SearchConfigurator class within the SuiteCRM\-Search namespace. It handles configuration for the search framework, including setting the search engine and saving configuration changes. It interacts with a Configurator object, facilitates fluent interface methods, and includes conditional logic for different search engine types.

classes.name: SearchConfigurator
classes.description: Handles configuration for the Search Framework, allowing setting of the search engine and saving configurations with a fluent interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SearchConfigurator with an optional Configurator object.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new SearchConfigurator with a fluent syntax.

methods.name: setEngine
methods.description: Configures the search engine, setting the controller based on certain engine names, and stores the engine name.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current configuration through the Configurator object.
